# Every new fully maxed combination

Game **3.0.0-development**. **2048** distinct legal completed builds contain a new specialization.

Development preview on `feature/dead-signal`. These links require the local preview server; the public release is unchanged.

“Maxed” means every remaining compatible upgrade is fitted, including boss salvage. These contain 50–62 upgrades: stress builds, beyond the ordinary run’s 19 picks. Different acquisition orders of the same gun are counted once. All five paths are included.

[Download the complete CSV](max-upgrade-combos.csv) · [Focused builds and controls](new-upgrade-builds.md)

Each expandable entry gives **every upgrade in a valid acquisition order**. Test links preserve Continue, Daily records, discoveries and Practice unlocks. Click the test button on the title screen; R repeats that preset.
